column1: # SUPER ROBOT WARS X on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# SDK 6, NVN, update 1.0.1 (v65536) with 6 DLC. The same engine as SUPER ROBOT WARS T (01006C900CC60000) and V (0100CA400E300000): subsdk0 and sdk byte for byte the same, so
# their settings carry over; the game profile beside this is the provisional one porter wrote from the survey (not checked by hand); the shader tables are its own (66 shaders,
# the same keys as V's). Text is drawn with the system shared font (nn::fontll): build with --shared-font <Korean TTF>, or the Korean text has no glyphs (the device's Roboto
# has no Hangul). The hero's names are typed in (build with --native-keyboard).
# Checked on the Retroid Pocket Nova (Adreno 740, Turnip T30, 2026-11-24, 1.0.1-1): title, new game, the six DLC mounted (Addcont 100 / 322 / 323 / 327 / 328 / 329), the
# opening movie, the chapter 0 dialogue and the first map, 60 fps (first map: 178-198 draws and 6 passes a frame, frame work p50 11-12 ms).
# Open: the opening movie (H.264, 2,125 packets in, 2,121 pictures out) stays black on its end until Switch B skips it (the decoder is never stopped by the game).
# Not set: DM_VK_ZC_CHUNK_MB=2048. It ends the "ranges across two chunks of a memory pool" warning (about one a frame from the title on, 16,384 by the first map) but in the
# chapter 0 dialogue every draw then ends its pass (167 passes for 168 draws a frame, frame work p50 13.5 ms, against 7 passes and 9 ms without it).
# Invalidate-only barriers keep the pass open, as for SUPER ROBOT WARS T (its android.tsv: menu 21 -> 60 fps on the Retroid Pocket Nova), V and 30
